actions.description: Share a doc with a user or make it public.
actions.name: add-permission

docId.description: ID of the doc to share. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

principalType.description: Type of principal to share with.

email.description: Email address of the user to share with. Required when principalType is "email".

suppressEmail.description: When true, suppresses the email notification.

actions.description: Create a new doc, optionally copying from a source doc.
actions.name: create-doc

title.description: Title of the new doc. Defaults to "Untitled".

folderId.description: ID of the folder to create the doc in. Example: "fl-1Ab234".

sourceDoc.description: ID of an existing doc to copy from. Example: "AbCDeFGH".

copyCompleted.description: Whether the async copy (if any) has completed.

copyWarning.description: Warning returned by the mutation status endpoint, if any.

actions.description: Create a new page in a doc.
actions.name: create-page

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

imageUrl.description: URL of the cover image to use.

parentPageId.description: The ID of this new page's parent, if creating a subpage.

actions.description: Permanently delete a doc.
actions.name: delete-doc

docId.description: The ID of the doc to delete. Example: "a97K6uAljP"

actions.description: Delete a page from a doc.
actions.name: delete-page

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

actions.description: Delete a single row from a Coda table.
actions.name: delete-row

docId.description: The ID of the document containing the table. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table containing the row. Example: "grid-123"

rowIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the row to delete. Example: "i-123"

requestId.description: The async request ID for tracking the mutation status.

actions.description: Delete multiple rows in a single request.
actions.name: delete-rows

docId.description: The ID of the doc containing the table. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table to delete rows from. Example: "grid-tE68GY5gIp"

rowIds.description: The IDs of the rows to delete. Up to 100 row IDs per call.

requestId.description: The mutation request ID for tracking async completion.

actions.description: Retrieve a single column by ID or name.
actions.name: get-column

docId.description: ID of the doc. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

tableId.description: ID or name of the table. Example: "grid-pqRst-U"

columnId.description: ID or name of the column. Example: "c-tuVwxYz"

actions.description: Retrieve a single control by ID or name.
actions.name: get-control

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

controlIdOrName.description: ID or name of the control. Example: "ctrl-F38u5bVLOn"

actions.description: Retrieve a single doc by ID.
actions.name: get-doc

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

actions.description: Retrieve a single named formula by ID or name.
actions.name: get-formula

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

formulaIdOrName.description: ID or name of the formula. Example: "f-fgHijkLm"

actions.description: Poll the status of an async mutation (page create/update/delete, row upsert, etc.).
actions.name: get-mutation-status

requestId.description: The requestId returned by an async mutation such as page create/update/delete or row upsert. Example: "request-123"

actions.description: Retrieve a single page by ID or name.
actions.name: get-page

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

pageIdOrName.description: Page ID or page name. Example: "canvas-51lnQjKXyv"

actions.description: Retrieve a single row by ID or name.
actions.name: get-row

docId.description: ID of the doc. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

tableIdOrName.description: ID or name of the table. Example: "grid-pqRst-U"

rowIdOrName.description: ID or name of the row. Example: "i-tuVwxYz"

useColumnNames.description: Use column names instead of column IDs in the returned output.

valueFormat.description: The format that cell values are returned as.

actions.description: Retrieve sharing capabilities for a doc.
actions.name: get-sharing-metadata

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

actions.description: Retrieve a single table or view by ID or name.
actions.name: get-table

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

tableIdOrName.description: ID or name of the table. Example: "grid-pqRst-U"

actions.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile and workspace info.
actions.name: get-user

actions.description: List Coda template categories.
actions.name: list-categories

actions.description: List columns in a table.
actions.name: list-columns

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "wGUhBwDpCh"

visibleOnly.description: If true, only returns visible columns.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List interactive controls (buttons, checkboxes, sliders) in a doc.
actions.name: list-controls

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Example: 25

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Retrieve analytics events for docs.
actions.name: list-doc-analytics

docId.description: ID of a doc to filter analytics. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

isPublished.description: Limit results to only published items.

sinceDate.description: Limit results to activity on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: "2020-08-01"

untilDate.description: Limit results to activity on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: "2020-08-05"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Example: 10

pageToken.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List docs accessible to the authenticated user.
actions.name: list-docs

query.description: Search term used to filter down results. Example: "Project Tracker"

isOwner.description: Show only docs owned by the user.

workspaceId.description: Show only docs belonging to the given workspace. Example: "ws-oZFDiLKJ45"

folderId.description: Show only docs belonging to the given folder.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Example: 10

pageToken.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List named formulas in a doc.
actions.name: list-formulas

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Maps to pageToken.

actions.description: List all pages in a doc.
actions.name: list-pages

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Example: 10

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List sharing permissions on a doc.
actions.name: list-permissions

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Example: 10

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (pageToken) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List rows in a table with optional filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-rows

docId.description: ID of the doc. Example: AbCDeFGH

tableIdOrName.description: ID or name of the table. Example: grid-pqRst-U

useColumnNames.description: Use column names instead of column IDs in the returned output

valueFormat.description: The format that cell values are returned as

sortBy.description: Specifies the sort order of the rows returned

visibleOnly.description: If true, returns only visible rows and columns for the table

query.description: Query used to filter returned rows, specified as <column_id_or_name>:<value>

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Maps to the pageToken parameter.

actions.description: List tables and views in a doc.
actions.name: list-tables

docId.description: ID of the Coda doc. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

tableType.description: Single table type to filter by. Do not use comma-separated values.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Update a page's name, subtitle, or icon
actions.name: update-page

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "L_hgEASd6n"

imageUrl.description: Custom image URL for the page icon

actions.description: Update cells in a specific row.
actions.name: update-row

docId.description: Doc ID. Example: "6O6-VWsNpq"

actions.description: Insert or update rows in a table.
actions.name: upsert-rows

docId.description: ID of the doc. Example: "AbCDeFGH"

tableId.description: ID or name of the table. Example: "grid-123"

cells.description: The cells to set for this row.

rows.description: The rows to insert or upsert.

keyColumns.description: Column IDs or names to use for upsert matching.

requestId.description: The request ID for tracking the async mutation.

warning.description: Warning if the mutation completed with caveats.

syncs.description: Sync columns for a configured doc and table.
syncs.name: columns

syncs.description: Sync interactive controls (buttons, checkboxes, sliders) for a configured doc.
syncs.name: controls

docId.description: ID of the doc to sync controls from

syncs.description: Sync all docs accessible to the authenticated user
syncs.name: docs

syncs.description: Sync named formulas for a configured doc
syncs.name: formulas

syncs.description: Sync pages for a configured doc
syncs.name: pages

syncs.description: Sync sharing permissions for a configured doc
syncs.name: permissions

syncs.description: Sync rows for a configured doc and table.
syncs.name: rows

docId.description: The ID of the Coda doc containing the table

tableId.description: The ID of the table to sync rows from

syncs.description: Sync tables and views for a configured doc
syncs.name: tables
